استسهلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَسْهَلُوا (istashalū) /is.tas.ha.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
# اُسْتُسْهِلُوا (ustushilū) /us.tus.hi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
# اِسْتَسْهِلُوا (istashilū) /is.tas.hi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
